clue.text: Sound advice for securing a small case?

indicators.note: said out loud, so the spoken words are heard as a single word with the same sound

parts.note: the advice you would give someone about fastening something is 'lock it'

explanation.surface: Someone asks for reliable tips on how to fasten a little box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable, but it signals that 'lock it' is heard as the word for the case.
explanation.definitionFit: A locket is a little hinged pendant case worn on a chain, usually holding a picture.

clue.text: Beat a doctor in the final

indicators.note: the letters for a doctor are placed inside the word for final

parts.note: the final one is the last
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A physician is defeated in a cup final.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beat' looks like part of a sports report, but it is the definition: to thrash or berate.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambast is to thrash or attack fiercely, either physically or in words.

clue.text: Establishment fleecing its customers

parts.note: a bar or club that overcharges its patrons outrageously; 'clip' also means to shear, as one fleeces sheep

explanation.definitionFit: A clip joint is slang for a nightclub or bar that swindles customers with exorbitant prices.

clue.text: They happen to upset Steven

indicators.note: Steven is knocked over, so his letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Things just happen in a way that troubles a man called Steven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges the six letters of STEVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Events are occurrences: things that take place or come about.

clue.text: Everyone is absorbed in the trial case

indicators.note: the word for everyone is taken into the middle of the word for trial

parts.note: a trial is a test
everyone taken one by one is each

explanation.surface: The whole public is gripped by the court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trial' and 'case' both look like court words, but here the case is a packing box.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea chest is a large wooden box, originally for shipping tea and later for packing when moving house.

clue.text: This way for a bet? You bet!

definitions.text: This way for a bet? You bet!

parts.words: This way for a bet? You bet!
parts.note: an ...-way bet backs a horse to win or be placed, and the phrase 'you bet' is in turn the kind of wager being named

explanation.definitionFit: Each way is a betting term for a stake split between a win and a place.

clue.text: Opening lines in court

parts.note: an opening is an opportunity or chance
RY, railway, gives railway lines

explanation.surface: The first words spoken in a court session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Opening lines' reads as one phrase about a speech, but splits in two; railway lines is a crossword convention. Chancery is a division of the English High Court.
explanation.definitionFit: Chancery is the division of the English High Court that hears equity and property cases.

clue.text: It may still be warm at the end of three months

definitions.meaning: a glowing piece of coal left in a dying fire

definitions.text: at the end of three months
definitions.meaning: the letters finishing the names September, November and December

explanation.definitionFit: An ember is a smouldering fragment of a fire, and three month names end in the same five letters.

clue.text: Produces nippers

parts.note: nippers looks like slang for small children, but here it means the biting teeth a baby grows

explanation.definitionFit: A baby teethes when its first teeth cut through the gums.

clue.text: One never scores with this girl

definitions.meaning: in cricket, an over in which the batsman makes no runs
an unmarried young woman, in old usage

explanation.definitionFit: A maiden over concedes no runs in cricket, and a maiden is an old word for a young unmarried woman.

clue.text: Mix-up in motor-cycle trial

definitions.meaning: an off-road motorcycle race over rough country

explanation.surface: A muddle at an off-road bike competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A scramble is both a disorderly rush and a motocross race over rough terrain.

clue.text: To many a new branch of medicine

indicators.note: the words are made new, so their letters are shuffled into another order

explanation.surface: Many people find a fresh field of medical study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the letters of TO MANY A.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomy, the study of the body's structure, is a basic discipline within medical science.

clue.text: Military assistant gives notice to project worker

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
to project is to stick out, to jut
the worker ant is the crossword's stock worker

explanation.surface: An army aide hands a labourer on a building project his notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'project' looks like a noun, but it is the verb meaning to stick out.
explanation.definitionFit: An adjutant is an officer who acts as administrative assistant to a commanding officer.

clue.text: Travel at full speed and overheat

definitions.meaning: an informal sense: to drive or race very fast
to burn the surface of something

explanation.surface: A car races flat out and its engine runs too hot.
explanation.definitionFit: To scorch is informally to race along, and also to singe by too much heat.

clue.text: Trap seen — ran out!

indicators.note: the words are put out of their order, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A suspect, spotted, flees out of a snare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the letters of SEEN and RAN together.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensnare is to catch in a snare, so it is a synonym of the verb meaning to catch.

clue.text: The expedition set off

definitions.meaning: to trigger a mechanism or alarm

explanation.surface: The team began its journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A trip is a journey, and to trip a switch or alarm is to activate it.

clue.text: Migrant workers in transit, moving round the east

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed around the letter for the east
the words are on the move, so their letters change places

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Travelling labourers are on their way, heading round the eastern region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges IN TRANSIT; 'round' puts that around E.
explanation.definitionFit: Itinerants are people who travel from place to place, often for seasonal work.

clue.text: He saw himself as winning on the pools

definitions.text: He saw himself as winning on the pools

parts.words: He saw himself as winning on the pools
parts.note: looks like a gambler on the football pools, but means the myth's youth who fell in love with his own reflection in a pool

explanation.definitionFit: Narcissus in Greek myth was a beautiful youth enchanted by his own image reflected in water.

clue.text: A leading Catholic priest is correct

indicators.note: the leading letter of the word Catholic is taken

parts.note: a curate is a junior priest or assistant clergyman

explanation.surface: A senior Catholic cleric is in the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading Catholic' reads as a prominent churchman, but only gives its first letter C.
explanation.definitionFit: Accurate means exactly right, free from error.

clue.text: Legal seizure of property from bond

definitions.meaning: the court's taking of assets to satisfy a debt

explanation.surface: Property taken by law from a security bond.
explanation.definitionFit: Attachment is the legal seizure of goods by court order, and also a feeling of affectionate connection.

clue.text: Misery that comes out in a gush

indicators.note: the words come out in a different form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Unhappiness pours out all at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes out' rearranges the letters of IN A GUSH.
explanation.definitionFit: Anguish is severe mental suffering or distress.

clue.text: Press for an element essential to life

definitions.meaning: to smooth clothes with a heated appliance
the metal Fe, needed for haemoglobin in blood

explanation.surface: A newspaper campaigns for something vital to living.
explanation.definitionFit: To iron clothes is to press them, and iron is a chemical element the body needs.

clue.text: Unnecessary loss of a point irritates

indicators.note: one letter standing for a point is lost from the longer word

parts.note: unnecessary means needless
S, south, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Giving away a point for no reason is annoying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loss of' takes S, a compass point, out of NEEDLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to provoke or annoy them persistently.

clue.text: It looks round quietly in sheer chaos

indicators.note: the letter for quietly goes inside the rearranged letters
sheer chaos means the letters of sheer are thrown into disorder

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone peers about calmly in complete disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chaos' rearranges SHEER, and 'in' puts P inside. 'looks round' reads as glancing about, but means is round in shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere is a perfectly round solid shape, like a ball.

clue.text: Freshly-made soup, for example, rises in price

indicators.note: the letters are made afresh, mixed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Home-made soup, say, has got more expensive.
explanation.definitionFit: When something costs more, its price is said to climb or increase.

clue.text: Designed to be a speedy vessel

indicators.note: the words are redesigned, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boat built with speed in mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Designed' rearranges the letters of TO BE A.
explanation.definitionFit: An E-boat was a fast German motor torpedo boat of the Second World War.

clue.text: Lead — or carbon actually

definitions.meaning: the writing core of a pencil
what that so-called lead really is: a crystalline form of the element carbon

explanation.surface: Pencil lead is really carbon.
explanation.definitionFit: Pencil 'lead' is in fact a soft black form of carbon, not the metal.

clue.text: Raise game although exhausted

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Raise game although exhausted' (4) for MEAT: no parse found from these words (game might be MEAT, but nothing accounts for 'Raise' and 'although exhausted'); likely an OCR garble, and no search gave the printed text.

clue.text: Fashionably tailored, he's concerned with his image

indicators.note: the word is fashioned into a new shape, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A smartly dressed man is preoccupied with how he looks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fashionably' rearranges TAILORED. 'his image' suggests vanity, but means a worshipped statue or idol.
explanation.definitionFit: An idolater worships idols, images of a god, so he is devoted to an image.

clue.text: Container ship?

definitions.meaning: a pot, jug or bowl that holds liquid

explanation.definitionFit: A vessel is both a hollow receptacle for liquids and a ship or large boat.

clue.text: Success with other treatment thus far

parts.note: a hit is a success

indicators.note: the word other is given treatment, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Getting good results with a different therapy, up to now.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto means up to this time, until now.

clue.text: When to tell all?

parts.note: looks like a time to reveal every secret, but 'tell' means count, as a bank teller counts; it is the time to count everyone

explanation.definitionFit: A census is an official count of a whole population.
